name: agent
description: Pi agent custom configuration and extensions

scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:extensions && bun run typecheck:packages && bun run typecheck:apps
scripts.lint: biome check extensions packages apps/dashboard-server apps/dashboard-web scripts
scripts.lint:fix: biome check extensions packages apps/dashboard-server apps/dashboard-web scripts --write
scripts.format: biome format extensions packages apps/dashboard-server apps/dashboard-web scripts docs
scripts.format:fix: biome format extensions packages apps/dashboard-server apps/dashboard-web scripts docs --write
scripts.dashboard:dist-smoke: bun run --filter @pi-dashboard/protocol build && bun run --filter @pi-dashboard/server build && node scripts/dashboard-dist-smoke.mjs
scripts.workspace:typecheck: bun run typecheck:packages && bun run typecheck:apps
scripts.check: node scripts/clean-npm-env.mjs sh -c "node scripts/check-node.mjs && node scripts/check-pi-sdk-version.mjs && bun run typecheck && bun run lint && vitest run extensions scripts && bun run workspace:test"
scripts.test: node scripts/clean-npm-env.mjs sh -c "node scripts/check-node.mjs && vitest run"
scripts.pi:sdk-sync: VERSION=$(pi --version) && TYPEBOX_VERSION=1.3.7 && bun add --exact @earendil-works/pi-ai@$VERSION @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent@$VERSION @earendil-works/pi-tui@$VERSION typebox@$TYPEBOX_VERSION && bun add --exact --filter @pi-dashboard/activity-model @earendil-works/pi-ai@$VERSION && bun add --exact --filter @pi-dashboard/server --filter @pi-dashboard/web --filter @pi-dashboard/extension-contributions typebox@$TYPEBOX_VERSION
